mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT n.* FROM note n
INNER JOIN note_tag nt ON n.id = nt.note_id
WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.is_deleted = FALSE
AND to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(n.title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(n.content, '')) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword})
AND nt.tag_id = #{tagId}
ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC
